facts.fact: Emerson 与 Magnus 在 Foundation 议事厅壁炉旁的红丝绒扶手椅里喝波本约两小时，看炉火熄灭。
facts.anchor: Together, Emerson and Magnus watched the fire recede until all that remained were charred logs atop hot embers.

facts.fact: Emerson 在 Catalogue 里待了一年、唯一稳定的同伴是 Adrien，回来后反而不习惯天天被人围着。
facts.anchor: After a year inside the Catalogue with Adrien as her only consistent source of company, Emerson was unaccustomed to being surrounded by so many people on a daily basis.

facts.fact: 自从她从 Catalogue 回来，Maya 坚持和她同住；Elias 又总跟着 Maya——她的小公寓日常挤着五个人。
facts.anchor: Since her return from the Catalogue, Maya had insisted upon staying with her. And these days, Elias went wherever Maya went.

facts.fact: Silas 从 Morsania Circo 回来后，Adrien 起初对她保持距离，但随着日子推移成了她家的常客。
facts.anchor: Adrien initially kept his distance from her after Silas returned from Morsania Circo.

facts.fact: Foundation 的 sleeper cells 按 III 类筛目标：最上面那类名单顶头写着 Elias 父母的名字。
facts.anchor: Emerson remembered blinking in surprise when Elias handed her the list and she found both of his parents’ names scrawled at the very top of the page.

facts.fact: Hayden 出发去昆仑山（Kunlun Mountains）找 Eastern Librarians 之后无人再有他的音信。
facts.anchor: No one had heard from him since he departed for the Kunlun Mountains.

facts.fact: Magnus 的绰号 Butcher 来自一千二百多年前他屠戮整个 Librarian 议会。
facts.anchor: the nickname he had acquired after slaughtering an entire Council of Librarians more than twelve centuries ago

facts.fact: 结尾 Emerson 问「这真的是战争吧」，Magnus 答「更糟——这是一场政治竞选」。
